jobs.label: io.aastar.dvt-committee-health
jobs.why: Runs local-heartbeat.sh in mode 'health': committee-health.mjs plus alerts, no transaction. The same wrapper's 'apply' mode broadcasts apply-verifier-rotation.mjs, so ONLY mode 'health' with exactly this wrapper (sha256 of master's deploy/local-heartbeat.sh) is reviewed; any change to the file or the mode fails launchd-off.
